context.transcript:
Thanks for inviting me to come to your camping store to demonstrate Tovan's newest portable lightweight stove.
I'll begin by handing you these brochures to look over later.
They describe this revolutionary new cooking device in detail, which should help you decide whether to stock it in your store.
The best part is, since this particular model is a scaled-down version of one of our larger models, you pay a fraction of the price, just $68.99.
Now let me show you just how easy it is to fold it and stick it in my backpack.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢你们邀请我来到贵店这家露营用品店，演示 Tovan 最新推出的便携式轻量炉具。
我先把这些宣传册交给你们，方便你们稍后查阅。
宣传册详细介绍了这款革新性的烹饪设备，应该能帮助你们决定是否在店内进货销售。
最棒的是，这个型号是我们某款较大型号的缩小版，因此只需花原价的一小部分，也就是 68.99 美元。
现在，让我演示一下，把它折叠起来并放进背包有多么容易。
